user.title: Connect the camera
user.description: The camera performs all face comparison and people counting. Home Assistant only reads. No camera setting is ever changed.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.

init.title: Techmark Attendance
init.description: Calendar settings take effect immediately. Time-of-day policy is saved but not applied — see that section for why.

menu_options.calendar: Working days, holidays and leave categories

calendar.title: Working days, holidays and leave
calendar.description: Default working week is Saturday to Thursday, with Friday off — change it freely. Holidays: one ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) per line. Leaving working days empty keeps the default.

employees.title: Choose an employee
employees.description: The roster is built from employees the camera has recognised.

employee_edit.title: {employee}
employee_edit.description: Approved leave: one entry per line, as “2026-12-01..2026-12-05 annual” or “2026-12-01 sick”. Leave working days empty to use the company list.

reports.title: Reports and retention
reports.description: Raw camera events are purged after the retention period. Presence history, employees and policy snapshots are permanent and are never purged.

data.report_dir: Report folder name (inside the config directory)
data.min_face_quality: Minimum face quality for anonymous detections

inactive_policy.title: Time-of-day policy — saved but not applied
inactive_policy.description: These values are stored and editable, but nothing is calculated from them. The camera reports no entry or exit direction on a face comparison, so a recognition timestamp cannot be treated as an arrival or a departure. Deriving late arrival, early departure, overtime, required-hours compliance or absence from it would be fabrication. They become active only if a verified direction source is added. The schedule below is shown as context on reports; change it freely.

data.schedule_confirmed: I have confirmed this schedule is correct
data.overtime_enabled: Calculate overtime (when a verified source exists)

error.bad_time: Times must be HH:MM in 24-hour form, or left blank.
error.bad_date: Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD, one per line.

abort.no_employees: No employees recognised yet. The camera must recognise someone from its Employee library first.

generate_report.name: Generate report
generate_report.description: Write an Excel report. Admin only.

date.name: Date
date.description: Any date inside the period. Defaults to today.

export_presence.name: Export presence CSV
export_presence.description: Recognised-presence CSV for a date range. Admin only.

recalculate.name: Recalculate a period
recalculate.description: Re-derive presence statuses after a calendar change. Raw events and stored timestamps are never modified.

list_libraries.name: List camera face libraries
list_libraries.description: Read-only summary of the camera's face libraries.
